rule: Each door belongs to the room that matches what it does, not its number. Door numbers and dates never change. Rooms run from the outer shell (1) to the core (7).

rooms.name: Capture
rooms.about: Getting things in: forms, open tabs, recordings, video and spoken answers turned into something you can use.

rooms.name: Memory
rooms.about: Keeping what you know: notes, decisions, search and context that a later session can find again.

rooms.name: Intent
rooms.about: Saying what you want: prompts, standing rules, specs and choosing the next piece of work.

rooms.name: Tools
rooms.about: Things you or your agent reach for to get one job done.

rooms.name: Agents
rooms.about: Running more than one agent, and jobs that keep going while you are away.

rooms.name: Checks
rooms.about: Proof before it ships: reviews, scans, audits, limits and hooks that refuse a risky step.

rooms.name: Recursion
rooms.about: The system reading its own output and making the next pass better.
